escrow_entitlement_fields_present.name: escrow_entitlement_fields_present
escrow_entitlement_fields_present.value:
"escrow_transactions"."tx_type" not in ('settle', 'withdraw')
          or ("escrow_transactions"."tx_hash" is not null
              and "escrow_transactions"."party" is not null
              and "escrow_transactions"."lane" is not null)

escrow_legacy_rows_have_no_entitlement_f.name: escrow_legacy_rows_have_no_entitlement_fields
escrow_legacy_rows_have_no_entitlement_f.value:
"escrow_transactions"."tx_type" in ('settle', 'withdraw')
          or ("escrow_transactions"."party" is null
              and "escrow_transactions"."lane" is null
              and "escrow_transactions"."destination" is null)

x402_settlements_settled_at_check.name: x402_settlements_settled_at_check
x402_settlements_settled_at_check.value: ("x402_settlements"."status" = 'settled' AND "x402_settlements"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("x402_settlements"."status" = 'in_flight' AND "x402_settlements"."settled_at" IS NULL)
